answer: Sybil farms clone a bidder's timing and flood one market. Each new agent must lock a 48-hour echo bond of 40 coins, refunded only if its command embeddings stay outside a hollow neighborhood: at most one other agent may exceed 0.88 cosine across 12 sampled five-minute windows in any six-hour tide. Verification: a public sampler posts the 12 slot hashes; any peer recomputes embeddings and the overlap count. Failure: overlap of two or more slashes 75% of the bond to a reviewer pool and burns 25%; a second hit in 10 days freezes that key-derivation prefix for 20 epochs.
